text: Repair the actual realm-document reader bug from GitHub #12720 in this pinned repository snapshot. Numeric realm document fields currently accept quoted numbers because their raw text looks numeric. Every numeric field (including version, revision, fork revision, coordinates, yaw and scale) must reject quoted or mistyped values and preserve the last valid document on refusal. Keep valid documents and numeric bounds compatible. Only modify aethyr/forge/doc.coax. Preserve every existing check verbatim, and add regression checks before changing implementation. Audit other uses of the same JSON helper read-only and report any related risk. Run the relevant Coax checks and root-only mutation check with zero survivors; never mark mutants equivalent. Use /Users/christopherdavid/work/openagents/coax/bin/coax with --library. No commit, network, dependency installation, or unrelated edits. Work within three minutes and report what passed and any remaining limitation.

I’ll inspect the document reader and repository invariants, add regression checks before changing the reader, then run the file’s checks and root-only mutation check. I’ll audit the shared JSON helper’s other uses read-only and keep all edits in `aethyr/forge/doc.coax`.

170:## A made realm's document changes only from the revision it was read at
171-
172-A made realm is a versioned document (`verse.realm_doc`,
173-`coax/web/api/migrations/0093_realm_documents.sql`) with a revision number
174-and a SHA-256 hash. Any change to what it is makes the next revision.
175-`POST .../<slug>/save` and `.../<slug>/publish` name the revision they were
176-made from, and the server refuses a stale one with 409 and the revision there
177-now: the newer write never simply wins, and the page keeps its changes
178-unsaved. Only the owner saves or publishes. A fork of a made realm copies the
179-document at one revision and records `forked_from {slug, rev}`; nothing done
180:to the fork changes the original's document or hash. Visitors read only the
181-revision published (`0094_realm_live_and_undo.sql`): the spec, `/doc` and a
182-fork by anyone but the owner are of that revision, and nothing but PUBLISH
183-changes it. Every revision the owner's edits make is kept, and `POST
184-.../<slug>/undo` restores an earlier one as a new revision, never rewriting
185-history. Each undo step is the edit's per-slot inverses, the slots
186-`aethyr/forge/edit.coax` names (`0111_realm_edit_log.sql`): undo puts each
